sections.content: Combine opinion, certainty, doubt, evaluation, justification and contrast to explain a position clearly.

items.spanish: No creo que sea la mejor opción, aunque entiendo el argumento.
items.english: I don't think it is the best option, although I understand the argument.

items.spanish: Estoy convencido de que debemos actuar porque el problema es importante.
items.english: I am convinced that we should act because the problem is important.

items.spanish: Es posible que existan otras soluciones, aunque de momento prefiero esta.
items.english: There may be other solutions, although for now I prefer this one.

sections.content: Layering is the skill being tested here: *estoy* *convencido* *de* *que* states a firm view, *porque* justifies it, and a trailing *aunque* clause can concede a limit — three moves in one sentence rather than three separate ones.
